purpose: Six distinct public yukkuri explainer channels define observable format families for six original, local-only benchmark reproductions.
selection_rule: Use only observable mechanics. Each reproduction must use an original script, original or independently licensed assets, and its own artifact identity.

authority.note: The 2026-08-04 user direction authorizes building all six original local reproductions. It does not authorize public upload or publication.

observable_contract.narration_model: measure host narration and location-led explanation
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure live property footage, detail inserts, and spatial orientation
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure title and explanatory subtitle hierarchy
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration, location sound, and music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure property facts and description-link practice

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure system, history, failure, and consequence ordering
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure maps, diagrams, archival evidence, and structural callouts
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure technical term and emphasis treatment
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure voice, effects, and background music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure cited-source granularity in description and frames

channels.channel_name: ゆっくり歴史解説チャンネル

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure setup, chronology, turning point, and aftermath
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure maps, portraits, diagrams, and event labels
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure dates, names, and emphasis treatment
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration and background music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure primary and secondary source presentation

observable_contract.chapter_model: hook, unit, near scale, solar scale, interstellar scale, galactic scale, implication, recap
observable_contract.visual_grammar: original scale diagrams, labeled cards, and numeric comparisons; no benchmark frames
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: two-line readable subtitles with numeric emphasis
observable_contract.asset_switching: one visual thesis per dialogue beat, grouped by scale
observable_contract.audio_grammar: YMM4 two-character TTS; no benchmark audio or voice copy
observable_contract.pacing: approximately one question-answer beat every 15 to 25 seconds
observable_contract.source_attribution: source card and review manifest list primary institutional references
observable_contract.intro_outro: question hook, ordered recap, and explicit close

channels.channel_name: ゆっくり災難資料館〖裏〗

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure conditions, timeline, failure chain, outcome, and lessons
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure route diagrams, object cutaways, chronology cards, and safety summaries
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure time, casualty, cause, and lesson emphasis
observable_contract.asset_switching: measure tension and evidence transition cadence
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration, restrained effects, and background music balance

observable_contract.chapter_model: measure document context, contents, claims, critique, and legacy
observable_contract.visual_grammar: measure book imagery, quotations, diagrams, and source cards
observable_contract.subtitle_grammar: measure quotation, title, author, and caveat hierarchy
observable_contract.audio_grammar: measure narration and background music balance
observable_contract.source_attribution: measure bibliography, quotation, and correction practice

current_gate.completed: Six channel identities and six distinct format-family contracts are locked and machine validated. The science family has one original 330-second local-viewable reproduction with an exact successor YMMP/MP4 receipt, unchanged 92-item voice/subtitle sequence, full decode, and four sampled-frame readbacks.
current_gate.next_slice: Keep the exact science successor pending artifact-bound human review in the Storage FB task, while measuring a representative civil-engineering-family video and authoring family two on a separate original artifact identity unless an immediate bounded science repair is requested.
